catalog.title: Life in the Fast Lane — Stable Life
catalog.description: Fifty-two weeks to turn two hundred dollars and a rented room into something that survives a bad month.
catalog.contentNotice: Seed content. The map, the scenario, the career ladder, 6 courses, 15 of 30 random events, 20 purchasable items, 8 NPCs and 3 starting backgrounds are authored; the rest is not yet written.

strings.stable-life.background.kitchen-hand.desc: A run of short-order jobs, none of them long enough to put on a résumé as one line.
strings.stable-life.background.kitchen-hand.name: Kitchen Hand
strings.stable-life.background.office-temp.descr: Two years of filling in for whoever was out. Nobody trained you; you just watched.
strings.stable-life.background.office-temp.name: Office Temp
strings.stable-life.background.overqualified-gra: A certificate, a stack of debt to match it, and a job market that has not read either.
strings.stable-life.campaign.description: Life in the Fast Lane — the Stable Life scenario. Fifty-two weeks to turn two hundred dollars and a rented room into something that survives a bad month.
strings.stable-life.campaign.title: Life in the Fast Lane — Stable Life
strings.stable-life.course.high-school-equivalen: Eight weeks to a piece of paper the last one should have already provided.
strings.stable-life.course.night-class-supervisi: Two evenings a week, a whiteboard, and the beginnings of telling other people what to do.
strings.stable-life.course.professional-certific: Sixteen weeks, a proctored exam, and a certificate suitable for framing or for nothing.
strings.stable-life.course.questionable-motivati: Nobody has ever explained what week nine covers. Week nine attendees have stopped asking.
strings.stable-life.course.university-degree-mod: Twenty-four weeks, one module of a longer degree, and the most expensive line item this scenario offers.
strings.stable-life.course.vocational-certificat: Sixteen weeks of a working kitchen, minus the part where anyone pays you for it yet.
strings.stable-life.difficulty.standard.label: Standard
strings.stable-life.event.apartment-viewing-offe: A studio on the next street is between tenants. It will not be for long.
strings.stable-life.event.appliance-breaks.descr: It gives one last hum and stops. Everything in it has opinions about that now.
strings.stable-life.event.appliance-breaks.title: The Fridge Dies
strings.stable-life.event.boiler-gives-up.descri: It had been making the noise for weeks. The noise has stopped, which is worse.
strings.stable-life.event.boiler-gives-up.title: The Boiler Gives Up
strings.stable-life.event.bus-fare-increase.desc: The board votes on a Tuesday no one attends. The fare box votes every day after.
strings.stable-life.event.car-breakdown.descript: Something under the hood decides today is the day.
strings.stable-life.event.car-breakdown.title: Car Breakdown
The equivalency certificate comes up in conversation and, for once, lands well.
strings.stable-life.event.dental-emergency.descr: A tooth that had been managing quietly for years decides to stop managing.
strings.stable-life.event.dental-emergency.title: Dental Emergency
A laminated certificate and a small cash bonus, in that order of perceived value.
strings.stable-life.event.friend-needs-a-favor.d: Priya asks for a Saturday. She has never asked for a Saturday before.
strings.stable-life.event.hardship-relief-paymen: A form filed months ago is finally worth something.
strings.stable-life.event.heatwave.description: The city holds the heat overnight and gives it back at eight in the morning.
strings.stable-life.event.heatwave.title: Heatwave
strings.stable-life.event.inflation-adjustment.d: Nothing on the shelf changed except the number under it.
strings.stable-life.event.job-interview-invitati: Someone read the application after all, and wants to meet the person who wrote it.
strings.stable-life.event.landlord-inspection.de: Two days' notice, delivered one day ago. Everything you own is now visible.
strings.stable-life.event.late-tax-filing-notice: A form due last season is due again, this time with a tone.
strings.stable-life.event.limited-time-sale.desc: A sign in the window insists this will never happen again. It happened last month too.
strings.stable-life.event.mugging-attempt.descri: Someone blocks the alley shortcut and asks, not very politely, for your wallet.
strings.stable-life.event.mugging-attempt.title: Mugging Attempt
strings.stable-life.event.neighbor-borrows-again: Tomasz needs the toolkit. Tomasz has needed the toolkit since March.
strings.stable-life.event.neon-sign-misunderstan: The neon sign in the window has been mistaken for a business. A form has been sent.
strings.stable-life.event.overtime-offered.descr: Someone called in sick. The hours are yours if you want them, and they are not good hours.
strings.stable-life.event.overtime-offered.title: Overtime Offered
strings.stable-life.event.pickpocketed.descripti: A crowd, a jostle, and a lighter pocket than you started the day with.
strings.stable-life.event.pickpocketed.title: Pickpocketed
strings.stable-life.event.pigeon-territorial-dis: A pigeon has decided the bicycle is its bicycle. It has brought documentation.
strings.stable-life.event.shift-schedule-cut.des: The schedule changes and a shift disappears from under you. The rent does not follow suit.
strings.stable-life.event.storm-damages-roof.des: Wind overnight, and a stain on the ceiling by morning that was not there before.
strings.stable-life.event.storm-repair-bill.desc: The roof is fixed. The invoice explains, at length, why it took three weeks.
strings.stable-life.event.surprise-bonus.descrip: The till balanced for once, and some of the difference lands in your pay.
strings.stable-life.event.surprise-bonus.title: Surprise Bonus
strings.stable-life.event.tax-penalty-assessment: The tone from two weeks ago becomes a number.
strings.stable-life.event.team-morale-day.descri: Someone brought a cake. It is being treated as a major event.
strings.stable-life.event.team-morale-day.title: Team Morale Day
strings.stable-life.event.tutor-offers-extra-ses: Mr. Alavi has a free hour and a strong opinion about how you should spend it.
strings.stable-life.event.winter-flu.description: Everyone at work had it. Now it is your turn, and the week has other plans.
strings.stable-life.event.winter-flu.title: Winter Flu
strings.stable-life.goal.financial-cushion.descr: Five hundred dollars in hand, and keep it there for eight straight weeks.
strings.stable-life.goal.financial-cushion.label: A Financial Cushion
strings.stable-life.goal.stable-life.description: Two thousand dollars, skilled work, sixty happiness, sixty health, and nothing overdue. Twelve months.
strings.stable-life.goal.stable-life.label: A Stable Life
strings.stable-life.housing.cheap-studio.descrip: One room, but it is the whole apartment, and nobody else's name is on the lease.
strings.stable-life.housing.cheap-studio.name: Cheap Studio
strings.stable-life.housing.decent-apartment.des: Enough rooms that guests no longer have to guess which pile is furniture.
strings.stable-life.housing.house.description: Four walls, times more than one, and a lawn nobody asked for.
strings.stable-life.housing.house.name: House
strings.stable-life.housing.rented-room.descript: The cheapest housing tier. It is a room, and it is rented, and the description has now told you everything it has.
strings.stable-life.housing.rented-room.name: Rented Room
strings.stable-life.item.basic-computer.descript: §10.2's remote-jobs-and-online-education unlock has nothing to write to.
strings.stable-life.item.basic-computer.name: Basic Computer
strings.stable-life.item.basic-toolkit.descripti: A wrench, a screwdriver, and the confidence that comes from owning them.
strings.stable-life.item.basic-toolkit.name: Basic Toolkit
strings.stable-life.item.first-aid-kit.descripti: Bandages, antiseptic, and the general sense that mistakes are now survivable.
strings.stable-life.item.first-aid-kit.name: First Aid Kit
strings.stable-life.item.folding-desk.descriptio: Somewhere to put things down that is not the floor.
strings.stable-life.item.folding-desk.name: Folding Desk
strings.stable-life.item.groceries-basic.descrip: A week's worth of food, bought all at once so it is over with.
strings.stable-life.item.groceries-basic.name: Basic Groceries
strings.stable-life.item.groceries-poor.descript: Cheaper, and it shows. Full all the same, eventually regretted.
strings.stable-life.item.groceries-poor.name: Bargain-Bin Groceries
strings.stable-life.item.impulse-espresso-machin: Used twice. Beautiful. Taking up the whole counter.
strings.stable-life.item.microwave.description: Cooking, in the sense that heating something up is cooking.
strings.stable-life.item.microwave.name: Microwave
strings.stable-life.item.novelty-neon-sign.descr: Says something in cursive. Hums all night.
strings.stable-life.item.novelty-neon-sign.name: Novelty Neon Sign
strings.stable-life.item.otc-medicine.descriptio: Takes the edge off. Reads nothing on the label about the actual cause.
strings.stable-life.item.otc-medicine.name: Over-the-Counter Medicine
strings.stable-life.item.paperback-novel.descrip: Somebody else's problems, bound and portable.
strings.stable-life.item.paperback-novel.name: Paperback Novel
strings.stable-life.item.prepaid-phone.descripti: Reachable, and one fewer thing to worry about forgetting.
strings.stable-life.item.prepaid-phone.name: Prepaid Phone
strings.stable-life.item.secondhand-coat.descrip: Someone else's winter, worn a second time.
strings.stable-life.item.secondhand-coat.name: Secondhand Coat
strings.stable-life.item.secondhand-guitar.descr: Three chords in, the neighbours already have opinions.
strings.stable-life.item.secondhand-guitar.name: Secondhand Acoustic Guitar
strings.stable-life.item.secondhand-mattress.des: An improvement over the floor, which was the previous mattress.
strings.stable-life.item.sewing-kit.description: A needle, thread, and one button that never finds its shirt again.
strings.stable-life.item.sewing-kit.name: Sewing Kit
strings.stable-life.item.threadbare-sofa.descrip: Comfortable in the specific way that a chair someone gave up on is comfortable.
strings.stable-life.item.threadbare-sofa.name: Threadbare Sofa
strings.stable-life.item.used-bicycle.descriptio: §10.2's travel-time reduction has nothing to write to. It still needs oiling.
strings.stable-life.item.used-bicycle.name: Used Bicycle
strings.stable-life.item.washing-machine.descrip: The laundromat, but it stays home.
strings.stable-life.item.washing-machine.name: Washing Machine
strings.stable-life.item.work-uniform.descriptio: §10.2's employability boost has nothing to write to. It still looks the part.
strings.stable-life.item.work-uniform.name: Work Uniform
strings.stable-life.job.data-entry-clerk.descrip: Entry tier. No credential required, per §6.1.
strings.stable-life.job.data-entry-clerk.title: Data Entry Clerk
strings.stable-life.job.dishwasher.description: Entry tier. No credential required, per §6.1 — just a sink and a willingness.
strings.stable-life.job.dishwasher.title: Dishwasher
Professional tier. §6.4: open positions here are finite and competed for.
strings.stable-life.job.line-cook.description: Skilled tier — §6.1's "demonstrated skill" is the Cooking skill, per §6.2's requirements list.
strings.stable-life.job.line-cook.title: Line Cook
strings.stable-life.job.retail-associate.descrip: Entry tier. No credential required, per §6.1.
strings.stable-life.job.retail-associate.title: Retail Associate
strings.stable-life.job.shift-supervisor.descrip: Professional tier. §6.4: open positions here are finite and competed for.
strings.stable-life.job.shift-supervisor.title: Shift Supervisor
strings.stable-life.job.systems-administrator.de: Skilled tier — §6.1's "demonstrated skill" is the Programming skill, per §6.2.
strings.stable-life.job.wifi-scapegoat.descripti: Senior tier — §6.1: scarce, track record plus reputation. §6.6's own joke ending for this chain.
strings.stable-life.job.wifi-scapegoat.title: Person Blamed When Wi-Fi Stops
strings.stable-life.location.bank.description: Two hops from Home, which is exactly as far as money should be.
strings.stable-life.location.bank.name: Bank
strings.stable-life.location.community-college.d: Two hops from Home. §16.2.1 notes its travel cost is the first lever to move if the certificate path proves impossible rather than merely hard.
strings.stable-life.location.department-of-forms: Enter cost 2, three hops from Home. You have to genuinely want that form.
strings.stable-life.location.employment-office.d: Where work is looked for, which is not the same as where work is found.
strings.stable-life.location.home.description: A cheap rented room. The hub of the map, and the only place four other places are one hop away from.
strings.stable-life.location.home.name: Home
strings.stable-life.location.market.description: Groceries, and the difference between the basic shop and the poor-quality one.
strings.stable-life.location.market.name: Market
strings.stable-life.location.recreation-area.des: The only place that improves two needs at once, and the first thing a full week deletes.
strings.stable-life.location.workplace.descripti: Wherever the current job happens. Indistinguishable from the last one.
strings.stable-life.location.workplace.name: Workplace
strings.stable-life.npc.bank-loan-officer.descri: Approves the borrowing and reviews the repaying. Reads the fine print out loud, slowly.
strings.stable-life.npc.bank-loan-officer.name: Mr. Petrov
strings.stable-life.npc.civic-office-coworker.de: Two desks over at the Civic Data Office. Knows exactly how long lunch can stretch.
strings.stable-life.npc.community-college-teache: Teaches whichever course is short a room. Grades on attendance more than he admits.
strings.stable-life.npc.diner-manager.descriptio: Runs the floor at the Greasy Spoon. Remembers who showed up for the double shift.
strings.stable-life.npc.diner-manager.name: Deb
strings.stable-life.npc.forms-clerk.description: Stamps the forms at the Department of Forms. Has seen every version of this form fail before.
strings.stable-life.npc.forms-clerk.name: Ms. Dinh
strings.stable-life.npc.landlord-rented-room.des: Owns the rented room and three others like it. Collects rent in person, on principle.
strings.stable-life.npc.next-door-neighbor.descr: Lives one door down. Borrows things and, to be fair, returns most of them.
strings.stable-life.npc.next-door-neighbor.name: Tomasz
strings.stable-life.npc.old-friend.description: Known since before any of this started. Still shows up at the recreation area on a bad week.
strings.stable-life.npc.old-friend.name: Priya
strings.stable-life.scenario.description: Two hundred dollars, no job, basic education, a rented room, one week of food, and fifty-two weeks.
strings.stable-life.scenario.name: Stable Life
strings.stable-life.skill.cooking.name: Cooking
strings.stable-life.skill.management.name: Management
strings.stable-life.skill.programming.name: Programming
strings.stable-life.trait.organized.description: Everything has a place, including the week itself.
strings.stable-life.trait.organized.name: Organized
strings.stable-life.trait.perfectionist.descript: Careful work, and a running commentary on everything not yet careful enough.
strings.stable-life.trait.perfectionist.name: Perfectionist
strings.stable-life.trait.thick-skinned.descript: Bad days roll off. A useful trait, in a scenario built almost entirely from bad days.
strings.stable-life.trait.thick-skinned.name: Thick-Skinned
